opening.argument: The video explains several ways to monetize Instagram through ordinary business activity. It identifies selling shout-outs, selling or flipping accounts, promoting products as an affiliate, and applying Instagram experience as a service for someone else. The agency and consulting method is also shown on screen. These are descriptions of possible activities, not a request for viewers to invest money, provide private information, or pay for a promised return. The sales calculation is illustrative rather than an established outcome. Although the speaker asks viewers to subscribe, that request functions as channel engagement, not a condition of a financial offer. The discussion remains general guidance about monetization methods, without establishing that any viewer will earn money from them.
